notes: Headless Chromium kept document.hidden false after bringing a second tab forward. Visibility tests therefore simulated the document.hidden getter and dispatched visibilitychange; actual OS/tab backgrounding was not verified.

Natural scrolling tested both directions without anchor clicks or hash changes. Hero, evidence and offer sections correctly clear active navigation. At the page-bottom limit, the reading line remains inside FAQs even while the closing section is visible, so FAQs correctly remains active; no claim is made that closing itself crossed the reading line.

Both deleted and undefined ResizeObserver fixtures passed: no script errors, correct header remeasurement after desktop-to-mobile resize, and active-section navigation remained functional. Native browser zoom was not exercised in this supplemental run.
